<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/chat/completions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The HackAgent LLM gateway, in OpenAI's chat completions format: point an OpenAI client at `https://api.hackagent.dev/v1` with a HackAgent API key. `model` picks one of HackAgent's models (`GET /v1/models`): `hackagent/attacker-v1`, which writes adversarial prompts, or `hackagent/judge-v1`, which judges responses. The response names that model only, never the upstream one.

Each call is charged to the organization's credits: its maximum cost (from `max_tokens`, capped at the model's limit) must be covered by the balance (402 otherwise), and its actual cost is deducted after it succeeds and logged (`GET /apilogs`). Streaming is not available (`stream: true` answers 501). Accepts an API key, a login token, or a cloud run's token, whose calls are charged to the run's organization. Errors use the gateway's own shape, `{"error": ..., "code": ...}`.
